review_boundary.evidence_distinction: Executed test results below come from inspected builder-produced logs. They are not independent reviewer executions.

inspected_evidence.assessment: All three production preparation paths supply section-specific CSS. Static worker boundaries remain intact.

Dependency collection shares import syntax and path resolution with rendering. Shortest-depth visits retain dependencies reachable through a later shorter route. Rendering retains its existing media decisions, order, cycle handling and depth limit.
Rendering and dependency collection share document-order enumeration of linked and inline sheets. Sorting dependency paths does not change rendering order.

Decode validates list structure and resource membership. The on-demand invariant checker also compares dependencies with admitted documents. Invalid records retain the existing preservation and re-admission path.
Worker tests inspect map contents inside real isolates. The unsendable Finalizer guards against capturing the Publication. Corrected red evidence reaches whole, partial and sample paths.
Builder logs report 1706 reader/crossings passes with 21 skips, followed by 3535 full-suite passes with 27 skips.

nonblocking_limits.evidence: 12-full.txt:1102 records failure; 13-frames-repeat.txt:62 and 14-full-repeat.txt:3783 record passing reruns.
nonblocking_limits.assessment: The test and scheduler are unchanged, and the fixture retains the same single stylesheet. This does not establish the failure's cause. No demonstrated defect in section CSS selection was found.

The evidence establishes fewer irrelevant map entries for the measured books. Immutable CSS strings are shared by Dart; it does not establish the survey's 90 MB copying claim. Sampling can repeat shared entries across selected maps, so reduction is not universal.
Ordinary decode checks structure, not semantic equality with document dependencies. Semantic equality remains an on-demand invariant check, matching the settled scope.
